controls.control: PHYSICAL_ORDERS_ENABLED is a build constant set to false; every physical write raises PhysicalOrderDenied without a runtime override.
All non-GET transport requests call the shared denial policy before credentials or network transport are accessed.

Hostile test opens legacy environment/stage/verdict locks, supplies credentials, forges the policy flag, and confirms place/cancel/write verbs never reach the injected transport. A static test constrains Kite order transport to the single guarded module.
Forged live flags and credentials do not let the forward paper runner invoke broker placement.
Live-paper and replay entry points do not invoke physical broker placement when live flags are forged.

scope_limit: This verifies broker-write unavailability in the repository's shipping execution paths and checked artifacts. It does not attest to external broker-account state or provider licensing.
